purpose: P1 A100 GPU Replication — frozen CPU configuration; independent backend experiment

inference.primary_efficiency_rule: Both frozen configurations have valid full eight-seed sets, meet both targets under both references, accuracy percentile upper bounds meet targets, and paired CV2/CV1 cost-ratio upper bound<=.9. Mean attainment and cost savings also reported separately; other targets pointwise exploratory.
inference.bootstrap_limit: Approximate conditional finite-cloud percentile intervals, not guaranteed population-W2 coverage; SW2 resampling bias retained and reported, not corrected post hoc.
inference.budget: Sampling+inference active elapsed <=43200s; 1999 draws required per reported interval; incomplete inference case censored; no fewer draws substituted.
inference.implementation: Pre-sorted projections and integer replica weights exactly match duplicated-cloud SW2 with S=2R; unit-verified against frozen metric.
inference.paper_role_rule: If material noise gap or conservative primary efficiency passes: supporting non-quadratic mechanism/conditional-efficiency benchmark. Otherwise null/limitation result in appendix or robustness section. German N=1000 and prior mixing limitations cannot establish the main large-N ill-conditioned superiority narrative.

initialization: Each independent replica starts at the frozen mode; Li accumulator starts at zero; exact frozen update rule retained.
randomness: JAX fold_in by seed, replica, purpose and global iteration; distinct from NumPy streams, same streams paired within JAX across methods.
failure: Nonfinite transition or frozen whitened radius >100 sqrt(d); permanently failed replica; any failed replica invalidates whole ensemble accuracy from that point, no survivor filtering.
references: Original frozen P0 scoring/calibration pools, projections, normalization and frozen per-seed 1024 subsamples; no new reference fit.
cost_primary: Anchor+actual transfer/cache/metric/state setup+first-use sampler compilation attributed to every standalone job+sampling; separate warm reuse sensitivity subtracts only compilation. Functional computation/scoring, instrumentation checks, output and research totals reported separately.
cost_limitation: Eager JAX setup combines cache and metric timing and may contain backend startup; setup operation classes recorded separately. Compilation measured once per kernel key, physical total and per-job attribution both retained. Hardware-specific efficiency only.
replication_scope: No GPU frontier optimization; reuse CPU final choices; no additional mixing claim without GPU multichain diagnostics.
